name: webai-at-home
description: Run one participant of the WebAI@Home cluster: the central gateway, the OpenAI-compatible server, the native worker, or the command line client, without cloning the repository.

scripts.build:dependencies: npm run build --workspace @webai/protocol && npm run build --workspace @webai/gateway && npm run build --workspace @webai/consumer-cli && npm run build --workspace @webai/consumer-openai && npm run build --workspace @webai/worker-openai && npm run build --workspace @webai/openai-test
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npx tsx --test tests/index.test.ts
scripts.prepack: npm run build:dependencies && npm run build && npx tsx scripts/vendor_wrapped_programs.ts
